Title: Question for LSJ about Martyr's Resiliance

Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
Martyr's Resiliance is "Only usable by an untapped vampire not
involved in the current combat". Can it be played by an untapped
vampire in torpor?

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Emmit Svenson" <emmits...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:75bdf7ed.01122...@posting.google.com...

> Martyr's Resiliance is "Only usable by an untapped vampire not
> involved in the current combat". Can it be played by an untapped
> vampire in torpor?

no. Reaction cards can't be played by a vampire in torpor unless specific
card text says so. eg : Crimson Fury.

Messages.Author: The Nosferatu Stuff
Messages.Body:
"Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote in message
news:a0dvd6$lti$2...@hadron.noos.net...


Well, you are right about reactions...but martyr's resiliance is a combat
card. And since I don't think there is any provision from playing combat
cards in torpor, you should be able to play it as long as you are untapped
with aus+for. There is however an errata that says: "Action modifiers
cannot be played by a vampire in torpor unless that vampire is the acting
minion" I can fore see that being expanded to include combat cards etc, but
that would be up to LSJ?
--
Aaron
The Nosferatu Stuff

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"The Nosferatu Stuff" <roans...@REMOVE.yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:JmxW7.20058$g96.3...@typhoon.mw.mediaone.net...


As the rules stand it seems to be legal. There's nothing in the rules that
states that a minion in torpor cannot play combat cards. Similar applies to
Infection, which has the same template as MR.

I would take it that the intent is either that both are playable by a minion
in torpor. Either that or the torpor rules need to be changed.

Without trying to be too picky, the action modifiers thing mentioned above
is not actually errata ( any more? ) it's in the rules.

Messages.Author: Max
Messages.Body:
> As the rules stand it seems to be legal. There's nothing in the rules that
> states that a minion in torpor cannot play combat cards. Similar applies to
> Infection, which has the same template as MR.

True, but it seems quite unlogical that a minion cannot enter combat
because of its torporized state, but he can play combat cards...
LSJ ?

Max
